deploymentEvidence.sourceType: official Ethereum Mainnet imUSD mapping plus independently reported exact proxy implementation
deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official legacy Developer Docs Ethereum Mainnet table identifies imUSD at this exact savings address. The pinned official tokens.ts independently maps mUSD on Chain.mainnet to the same savings address. Exact-address Etherscan and Sourcify report the same deprecated implementation; neither the original SavingsContract source nor the historical ERC4626 documentation is substituted for it.
limitations: Reported proxy resolution is an evidence-service observation, not a live RPC/storage attestation.
The official mainnet Chain enum is an internal network enum, not numeric chainId 0; Ethereum Mainnet documentation and chain-1 explorer/Sourcify establish chainId 1.
The applicable implementation is explicitly deprecated and exposes only exits; ordinary deposits requested for investigation cannot truthfully be admitted.

abiEvidence.sourceType: exact deployed implementation ABI/source plus exact proxy ABI/source
abiEvidence.catalogAbiNormalization: Full original ABI retains legacy constant/payable flags. Selected catalog fragments omit only these redundant flags after checking consistency with stateMutability; input/output types, names, order and mutability remain deployment-bound and unchanged.
abiEvidence.evidence: Top-level abi retains the full 52-entry implementation ABI (37 functions and 15 events) followed by the full 10-entry proxy ABI (7 functions, 2 events and fallback), without a duplicate full ABI. functionInventory reviews all 44 callable function entries, marking abiOrigin. The implementation has no deposit/mint, permits, callbacks or executor functions; events named Deposit/SavingsDeposited and interface comments do not create entry capabilities. Proxy admin/upgrade/initialize and opaque upgrade calldata are individually excluded. Verified source identifies SavingsContract (deprecated), author dHEDGE. No generic ERC4626/fork interface is used.

website.notes: Live attributable developer reference with exact Ethereum imUSD deployment mapping, not a parked domain or an active-product promise. Content is historical and still documents removed deposit/mint functions. The old repository README links docs.mstable.org; that live site now describes Stacked Yield, not this legacy savings contract. Use the deployment-specific Developer Docs reference for this frontend entry.

lifecycle.removedEntrySurface: No deposit, depositSavings, mint, previewDeposit, previewMint, maxDeposit or maxMint functions in the applicable exact implementation ABI. No entry capability is fabricated from historical docs or older SavingsContract source.
lifecycle.standardCompatibility: The prior 2.2 savings contract added ERC4626-shaped methods. The current deprecated implementation retains only withdrawal/redeem and read methods, so complete ERC4626 compliance is not asserted.

selectedFunctions.label: Redeem imUSD shares for mUSD to receiver
warnings: Burns owner shares and pays the selected nonzero receiver. If caller differs from owner, a sufficient pre-existing share allowance is required and spent unless it is uint256 maximum; this record does not authorize setting allowances.

Legacy exit-only imUSD deployment: the applicable SavingsContract_imusd_mainnet_22_deprecated implementation has no deposit, depositSavings or mint functions. Historical SAVE documentation describes a wider interface and is not the authoritative ABI for this proxy today.

Upgradeable EIP-1967 InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy: Etherscan and Sourcify report implementation 0x0bc67971b49F7c23704c064F57B40d42A9B6f2B6 at review. Administration may replace it; no live bytecode/storage identity guarantee, admin or upgrade capability is supplied.

Conversions use stored exchangeRate scaled by 1e18, not a fixed 1:1 imUSD/mUSD rate: asset payout floors shares * rate / 1e18; exact-asset exits burn floor(assets * 1e18 / rate) + 1 credits, including the extra credit when division is exact. Positive tiny share input may burn shares for zero mUSD.

No caller-set minimum mUSD output, maximum shares burned or deadline. All selected calls are nonpayable and require zero native value; caller must choose amounts and, where applicable, intended owner and nonzero receiver.

If the private stored automateInterestCollection flag is enabled, every exit first calls the SavingsManager resolved through fixed Nexus 0xAFcE80b19A8cE13DEc0739a1aaB7A028d6845Eb3. Those current stored dependencies/flags are not attested; dependency behavior or reverts may prevent exit.

Underlying is fixed mUSD 0xe2f2a5C287993345a840Db3B0845fbC70f5935a5, not DAI/USDC or native ETH. Transfer occurs from raw savings-contract balance before any connector rebalance; insufficient raw balance can revert even if funds exist in a connector. This admission does not redeem mUSD into its basket assets.

After burning shares and transferring mUSD, an exit can trigger internal connector _poke when inferred connector exposure exceeds fraction + 20%. It enforces more than four hours since last poke, connector balance/yield checks and nondecreasing exchange-rate rules; calls/checks can revert the entire exit. There is no independent user withdrawal queue/cooldown, but this conditional poke cadence can block settlement.

No API-key grants or execution controls are added. Source/ABI evidence does not establish live configuration, rate freshness, balances, backing, liquidity, successful execution, continued yield or financial safety.
